name: Post-Scrutiny Refinement Phase Declaration
purpose: Declare the participatory refinement phase and establish anti-expansion governance rules for semantic compression.

phase_definition.canonical_statement: The post-scrutiny refinement phase permits the reduction of semantic redundancy and the tightening of operator roles to achieve framework simplicity without permitting conceptual expansion.
phase_definition.core_principle: Compression is preferred over expansion whenever semantic coverage is preserved.

governance_rules.rule: Conceptual expansion or new law creation is prohibited; existing structures must be simplified or merged.
Every compression step must preserve the foundational ⇔R relation and failure visibility.
No deletion of logical detail is permitted without an explicit supersession trace.

non_claims: Tightened roles justify global claim escalation.
